channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Alex Abrines | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Alex Abrines from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: LeBron James on Alex Abrines
item.description:
And he fondly recalls an anecdote with LeBron James :

“I have an anecdote that after a game against Cleveland, I crossed the court to greet Calderón and Lebron crossed, shook my hand and said 'good job Abrines' and I said this guy is better than Jordan, he knows my name, I mean, this is my idol now.”

LeBron James on Alex Abrines, Jan 22, 2026. Source: COPE.

item.title: Billy Donovan on Alex Abrines
item.description:
Brett Dawson:Billy Donovan on Alex Abrines:

“Even though he’s not gonna be a part of our team anymore, we’re all still here. He’s still part of the family,and we’ll do anything we can to try to help him going forward.”

Billy Donovan on Alex Abrines, Feb 9, 2019. Source: Twitter @BDawsonWrites.

item.title: Billy Donovan on Alex Abrines
item.description:
Maddie Lee:Billy Donovan on Alex Abrines (personal), who wasn’t at the arena tonight:

“Alex has been great. He’s around the team,he’s around us, we’re communicating, we’re talking, so it’s been very transparent and open.”

Billy Donovan on Alex Abrines, Feb 5, 2019. Source: Twitter @maddie_m_lee.

item.title: Billy Donovan on Alex Abrines
item.description:
Fred Katz:Donovan on Abrines:

“I don’t think he’s in rhythm. Physically, he’s still trying to get back to where he was maybe a year ago. I think for people that watched him play last year, they can see that he’s not really physically the same level he was at.”

Billy Donovan on Alex Abrines, Jan 8, 2018. Source: Twitter @FredKatz.

item.title: Billy Donovan on Andre Roberson, Alex Abrines
item.description:
Erik Horne:Billy Donovan on Alex Abrines’ defense:

“He’s never going to be Andre Roberson,but he can be a good team defender.”

Billy Donovan on Andre Roberson, Alex Abrines, Dec 29, 2017. Source: Twitter @ErikHorneOK.

item.title: Victor Oladipo on Alex Abrines
item.description:
Spanish rookie Alex Abrines, however, showed how important he could be to the team built around the driving duo of Oladipo and Westbrook by making four of his five 3-pointers.

“(Abrines) is going to be huge for us. We need him, the way he shoots the ball, the way he can open up the lane for me and Russ, the way he spreads the floor,”

Victor Oladipo on Alex Abrines, Oct 4, 2016. Source: USA Today Sports.
